description: Test the functionality of accessing the privacy policy from the footer and ensure the privacy policy page loads correctly.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Scroll down to the footer section.
Redirect to the privacy policy page at https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Verify the presence of privacy terms and conditions.
Confirm the content is readable and accessible.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Privacy policy content is available and readable.
Privacy terms are complete and accurate.
edge_cases: Privacy policy link is broken or leads to a 404 error.
Network issues prevent the privacy policy page from loading.
The 'Privacy Policy' link is missing or disabled.
Privacy policy content is incomplete or inaccessible.
Page takes too long to load.
data_requirements: Valid privacy policy link configured in the footer.
User has permissions to view privacy policy resources.
Session cookies for maintaining navigation state.
dependencies: Privacy policy pages are properly hosted.
User has access to the internet.
performance_metrics: Measure the page load time for the privacy policy page.
Ensure the privacy policy page is responsive.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Privacy Policy' link has an accessible name or ARIA label.
Validate that keyboard navigation allows interaction with the 'Privacy Policy' link.
Confirm that privacy policy content is screen-reader compatible.
